stories.headline: Tua's Laid Up, Cooper Rush Rides In For the Falcons
stories.read: Pardner, the wire says Falcons QB Tua Tagovailoa twisted up his ribs in Thursday drills and he's nursin' an oblique injury, out for Sunday's showdown at Pittsburgh. Cooper Rush saddles up under center instead, and that's a downgrade for the whole Atlanta outfit, not just the quarterback spot. Drake London still eats regardless of who's slingin' it, he's the surest hand in that barn, but anybody bankin' on big air yards outta this offense oughta pump the brakes till Tua's back in the saddle.

stories.headline: Bowers Goes Under the Knife, Mayer Stakes a Claim on the Open Range
stories.read: Raiders TE Brock Bowers had himself a meniscus trim this week and he's out to start the season, with the outfit hopin' he's back in the saddle by Week 2 or 3. That leaves Michael Mayer holdin' the reins at tight end for Vegas, and that's free land for whoever stakes it first on the waiver wire. Bowers is still the horse to bet on long term, but there's a short window here for Mayer to pad his own resume before the big fella rides back in.

stories.headline: Jeremiyah Love Trendin' Right, But He's Ridin' Shotgun, Not Drivin' the Wagon
stories.read: Cardinals rookie Jeremiyah Love is trendin' the right direction off that high-ankle sprain and looks fixin' to suit up Sunday against the Chargers. Here's the catch: he's listed behind Tyler Allgeier on the pecking order, so this ain't the workhorse debut some of you drafted him for. Stash him deep in the saddlebag, he's still got bell-cow written all over him down the trail, just don't ride him as your RB1 outta the gate.
